episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to product operations | Melissa Perri and Denise Tilles
episodeTitle.zh: 产品运营终极指南 | 梅丽莎·佩里（Melissa Perri）与丹妮丝·蒂勒斯（Denise Tilles）

guestBioOfficial.en: Melissa Perri is the CEO of Produx Labs, a product management training organization; author of the seminal PM book The Build Trap; and a former Harvard Business School professor of product management. Denise Tilles is the CPO at Grocket, Melissa’s colleague at Produx Labs, and a seasoned product leader with over a decade of experience. Together they authored the new book Product Operations: How successful companies build better products at scale. In today’s episode, they share insights, strategies, and real-world experiences to master all things product ops. We discuss: • What exactly product operations is
guestBioOfficial.zh: 梅丽莎·佩里（Melissa Perri）是产品管理培训机构Produx Labs的首席执行官，权威PM著作《The Build Trap》的作者，同时曾任哈佛商学院产品管理教授。丹妮丝·蒂勒斯（Denise Tilles）是Grocket公司的首席产品官，也是梅丽莎在Produx Labs的同事，她拥有十余年丰富的产品管理经验。两人合著新书《Product Operations：成功公司如何大规模打造优质产品》。在本期节目中，她们将分享见解、策略及真实案例，助你精通产品运营全领域。我们将探讨：• 产品运营究竟是什么？

title.en: The ultimate guide to product operations | Melissa Perri and Denise Tilles
title.zh: 产品运营终极指南 | 梅丽莎·佩里（Melissa Perri）与丹妮丝·蒂勒斯（Denise Tilles）

summary.en: Melissa and Denise make the case for a dedicated product operations function that handles shared systems so PMs can focus the majority of their time on strategic work. They explain the emerging role of product ops and how to build it at scale. The episode is a deep dive into a critical but often missing piece of modern product organizations.
summary.zh: 梅丽莎和丹尼斯论证了：应设立专门的产品运营职能来处理共享系统，让 PM 能把大部分时间聚焦在战略工作上。她们解释了产品运营这一新兴角色，以及如何在规模上构建它。本期深入探讨了现代产品组织中关键却常被缺失的一环。
